nodes.text: A claims manager wrote, 'The DOI issued newer claim guidance; review the workflow.' The note has no jurisdiction, source number, version, effective date, or quoted change.
Workflow v1.9 includes a 10-day diary and is described as current in a draft diagram, but no production deployment date or environment is supplied.
Ticket REG-900 is open for investigation; it does not identify the rule or expected workflow behavior.
